watches.name: Core Diver - Jungle Malachite - Preorder
watches.description: Core Diver Jungle Malachite Formed Layer by Layer. Tested to 600 Meters. Deep green. Wild bands. A dial that looks like the canopy from above. But the real story of malachite is older than any jungle legend. More than 7,000 years ago, someone put a green stone in a fire and watched copper run out of it. That stone was malachite. It started the Copper Age, then the Bronze Age, and a lot of what came after. Now it sits under sapphire on a dive watch built to go deeper than you ever will. The Core Diver Jungle Malachite has a dial cut from genuine malachite. Its surface is banded with light and dark green stripes, rings and swirls that no machine could copy. Only 100 will be made, and no two are the same. Your Dial Is the Only One Like It Malachite grows in layers. Copper-rich water laid down each band, one thin line at a time, over thousands of years. Every slab is cut, polished and set by hand, so the dial on your wrist is a one-off. Some show tight, even stripes. Others have bold bands or rings. Move it under sunlight, office light or a dive torch and the bands shift with it. The watch you receive will be yours alone. Applied silver indexes, bold baton hands and Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova keep it easy to read, whether you're 30 meters down or at dinner. Why Malachite Malachite is the stone that got metal started. It was one of the first copper ores people learned to smelt. Copper led to bronze. Bronze led to tools, ships, trade and cities. It's been prized ever since. Ancient Egyptians ground it into green eye paint. Renaissance painters used it as pigment. Russia's tsars lined whole rooms with it. The Malachite Room in the Winter Palace is still one of the most famous rooms in the world. It's a soft stone, which is why you rarely see it on a tool watch without serious protection. Ours sits sealed under 4.0mm of sapphire in a case tested to 600 meters. An ancient stone with a modern shield around it. Built Like Every Core Diver Behind the stone is the same tool watch our customers trust in open water. Every Core Diver is pressure-tested in water before it ships and assembled in the USA by our watchmakers. 600m / 2,000ft water resistance, individually tested Swiss Sellita SW200-1 automatic movement, regulated for added accuracy, with no battery to replace 4.0mm sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Unidirectional 120-click bezel with Swiss C3 lume markers Automatic helium escape valve at 9 o'clock 316L stainless steel case with brushed finishes Guaranteed accuracy for at least 5 years In the Box Shark mesh bracelet with ratchet extension clasp, plus a crazy horse leather strap. Wear the bracelet diving on Saturday and the leather to dinner on Sunday. Technical Specs Case Diameter: 44mm (excluding crown) Thickness: 15.6mm | Lug-to-Lug: 50mm | Lug Width: 22mm Case: 316L Stainless Steel Dial: Genuine Malachite Crystal: Sapphire, 4.0mm, anti-reflective Bezel: Unidirectional, 120 clicks, Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova markers Movement: Swiss Made Sellita SW200-1 Automatic Frequency: 28,800 vph | Power Reserve: 40 hours Water Resistance: 600m / 2,000ft / 60 ATM Helium Escape Valve: Automatic, 9 o'clock Bracelet: Updated Shark Mesh with Ratchet Extension Clasp + Crazy Horse Leather Strap Edition: Limited to 100 pieces FAQ Will my dial look exactly like the photos? No, and that's the point. Every dial is natural malachite, so the banding varies from piece to piece. Yours will be unique. Is a stone dial durable enough for diving? Yes. The dial is sealed under 4.0mm of sapphire inside a case tested to 600 meters. Water and pressure never touch it. It sees no more stress than any other dial. Will there be more? No. Once the 100 dials are gone, this edition is closed. Only 100 Will Be Made Malachite helped start civilization. Once this run sells through, it's gone. Claim yours.

watches.name: Crawler One - Red Star Meteorite LE - Preorder
watches.description: Ocean Crawler Crawler One – Red Star Meteorite Red Meteorite Dial Edition From the stars. Built for the deep. Genuine meteorite dial : no two are alike Deep red PVD finish that won't fade or chip Water-resistant to 2,000 feet Swiss automatic movement , assembled by hand in the USA Limited to 100 pieces A Piece of Space on Your Wrist The dial is cut from real meteorite , one of the rarest materials on Earth . It drifted through space for billions of years before it fell here, and only a small fraction of meteorites that reach the ground are ever found. We finish each dial in deep red using a PVD process , which bonds the color to the metal at a molecular level. The meteorite's natural crystal pattern still shows through. Every slice is different, so your dial is one of one . Nobody else will have the same watch. Mars glows red because its surface is covered in iron oxide. Red giant stars like Betelgeuse burn red near the end of their lives. And the iron inside meteorites, the same iron in your blood, was forged inside stars long before Earth existed. The Red Star dial brings that color home: iron from space, finished in the color of the stars that made it. Tough Enough to Back It Up A beautiful dial means nothing if the watch can't take a hit. Every Crawler One goes through ten drop tests , including a hammer test that hits it with about 6,000 G of force . It keeps running and keeps time. Every watch is also pressure-tested past its 2,000-foot rating before it ships. Take it scuba diving, spearfishing, or swimming. Wear it every day. Inside is a regulated Swiss Sellita SW200-1 automatic movement . There's no battery; it winds itself as you wear it. Each one is assembled by hand in the USA . Two straps included: a waterproof canvas strap for the water and a leather strap for everything else. Why the Crawler One Stands Apart Real water resistance to 2,000 feet (600 meters) Helium release valve Shock resistance to 6,000 G Swiss automatic movement , no battery needed 3.5mm domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Guaranteed to keep precise time for at least 5 years Technical Specs Case diameter (excluding crown): 41mm Case thickness: 14mm | Lug-to-lug: 48mm | Lug width: 20mm Case material: 316L stainless steel Bezel: Unidirectional, 120 clicks, Swiss Super-LumiNova markers Movement: Sellita SW200-1, regulated to +/- 8 seconds/day in 3 positions Water resistance: 600m / 2,000 ft / 60 ATM Dial: Genuine meteorite, red finish Only 100 Red Stars will be made. When they're gone, they're gone. Claim yours now.

watches.name: Ocean Crawler Dual Watch Travel Case — Genuine Leather Watch Roll, Navy
watches.description: Two watches. One case. Zero worry. If you've ever wrapped a watch in a sock and shoved it in a carry-on, this is for you. The Ocean Crawler Dual Watch Travel Case holds two watches side by side in soft cushioned pillows, so nothing rattles, scratches, or bumps against a bracelet clasp on the way to wherever you're going. The shell is genuine pebbled leather in deep navy, cut and stitched by hand. Inside, a cream microsuede lining wraps every surface your watch touches. The flap folds over and locks down with solid brass-tone snaps — no zippers to snag a crystal, no Velcro to wear out. Our logo is blind-embossed into the front. No loud branding, just the mark. It's sized for real dive watches. A 44mm case on a thick rubber strap fits without a fight, and the pillows are firm enough to hold shape but soft enough that you're not forcing anything into place. Rolls into a weekender. Lives on a nightstand. Does both well. Details Holds 2 watches Genuine pebbled leather exterior, navy Cream microsuede interior lining Two removable cushioned watch pillows Brass-tone snap closure Blind-embossed Ocean Crawler logo Fits watches up to 48mm case diameter, including dive bezels Dimensions: 9 x 4 x 5 inches

watches.name: Bolt - Space Gold DLC - Genuine Meteorite
watches.description: Bolt – Space Gold DLC - Genuine Meteorite dial SPACE GOLD GOES DARK. Introducing the Ocean Crawler Bolt – Space Gold DLC , a striking new interpretation of one of our most distinctive meteorite watches. At its center is a genuine Muonionalusta meteorite dial , formed more than 4.5 billion years ago and plated in rich 18K gold . Every dial reveals its own naturally occurring crystalline Widmanstätten pattern, meaning no two watches will ever look exactly alike. For this edition, that extraordinary gold meteorite is surrounded by a stealth black DLC-coated case , creating a dramatic contrast between deep black and brilliant gold. Ancient material. Modern engineering. Built for the depths. 4.5 BILLION YEARS IN THE MAKING The meteorite used for the Space Gold DLC is cut from genuine Muonionalusta meteorite , one of the oldest meteorites ever discovered. Estimated to be approximately 4.565 billion years old , this material predates Earth itself. Each section of meteorite reveals a unique crystalline structure created through an unimaginably slow cooling process in space. Because these patterns occur naturally, every Space Gold DLC dial is completely unique . The meteorite is then plated in 18K gold , transforming this ancient extraterrestrial material into a dial that changes character as light moves across its surface. You aren't simply wearing a meteorite-inspired dial. You're wearing an actual piece of space history. BLACK DLC. 18K GOLD METEORITE. The black DLC treatment completely changes the personality of the Space Gold. The deep black case and bracelet create a stealth backdrop for the gold meteorite dial, allowing its natural crystalline structure to become the visual centerpiece of the watch. The result is a combination of black, gold and meteorite that can look aggressive in one light and remarkably refined in another. DLC — Diamond-Like Carbon — is an extremely hard surface coating valued for its durability and resistance to wear, making it an ideal finish for a serious dive watch. BUILT LIKE A BOLT Despite its professional dive specifications, the Bolt maintains an exceptionally wearable profile. At just 12.3mm thick , the 42mm case combines substantial water resistance with a streamlined integrated design that wears comfortably every day. Every Ocean Crawler Bolt is individually pressure tested and engineered for water resistance to: 600 METERS / 2,000 FEET / 60 ATM Whether it's taken underwater or simply becomes the centerpiece of a collection, the Space Gold DLC was designed to be worn—not kept in a safe. SWISS AUTOMATIC POWER Inside the Space Gold DLC is the proven Swiss-made Sellita SW200-1 automatic movement , regulated for enhanced accuracy. Operating at 28,800 vibrations per hour , the SW200-1 delivers the smooth sweep and mechanical character collectors expect from a Swiss automatic timepiece. No batteries. Just mechanical engineering powered by the movement of your wrist. SAPPHIRE ABOVE. SAPPHIRE AROUND. The Bolt features a thick 3.5mm sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating along with a 120-click unidirectional sapphire dive bezel . Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova on key elements provides powerful visibility when the lights disappear. A DIAL NO ONE ELSE CAN OWN Natural meteorite makes every Space Gold DLC different. The lines, intersections and crystalline structures visible across your dial belong to that individual section of meteorite. There isn't another one exactly like it. For collectors accustomed to mass-produced dials, that's what makes meteorite so compelling. Nature created the pattern. Space created the material. Ocean Crawler built the watch around it. watches.description: Ocean Crawler Bolt: Electric Reef The Reef Never Stands Still. Neither Should Your Watch. The Ocean Crawler Bolt: Electric Reef returns with three vibrant new editions inspired by some of the ocean's most captivating reef inhabitants — Mantis Shrimp , Lionfish , and Damselfish . Designed for those who appreciate both adventure and individuality, the Bolt combines the rugged capability of a professional dive watch with an exceptionally slim profile rarely found in watches built for extreme depths. At just 12.3mm thin , the Bolt wears effortlessly on the wrist while delivering a remarkable 600 meters (2,000 feet) of water resistance . Whether you're exploring coral reefs, traveling the world, or simply looking for a watch that stands apart from the ordinary, the Bolt was built to go wherever life takes you. Each colorway captures the energy, beauty, and unpredictability of life beneath the surface — transforming a professional-grade dive watch into a statement piece you'll reach for every day. Engineered for the Ocean. Refined for Everyday Wear. Most dive watches capable of reaching 600 meters are bulky, heavy, and designed solely for underwater use. The Bolt was engineered differently. Its integrated bracelet, sleek proportions, and ultra-thin profile create a wearing experience that feels remarkably comfortable from the office to the open ocean. Yet beneath its refined appearance lies the same uncompromising durability Ocean Crawler is known for. Every Bolt is individually pressure-tested and built to perform in conditions far beyond what most owners will ever encounter. The result is a watch that delivers confidence whether you're scuba diving, spearfishing, boating, traveling, or simply appreciating exceptional craftsmanship on your wrist. Because a great dive watch shouldn't force you to choose between performance and comfort. Built to Be Seen When It Matters Most Visibility is everything underwater. The Bolt features an all-sapphire unidirectional bezel with markers filled using seven layers of Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova , creating an exceptionally bright and long-lasting glow in low-light conditions. A thick 3.5mm anti-reflective sapphire crystal provides outstanding clarity while resisting scratches from everyday wear and adventure alike. As light fades beneath the surface, the Bolt remains easy to read, dependable, and ready for whatever lies ahead. Swiss Precision Inside At the heart of every Bolt beats the renowned Swiss Sellita SW200-1 automatic movement . Operating at 28,800 vibrations per hour , this proven mechanical caliber is regulated for accuracy and chosen for its reliability, serviceability, and decades-long track record among enthusiasts. No batteries. No charging cables. Just the timeless satisfaction of a precision mechanical movement powered by the motion of your wrist. Limited Production. Built in Small Batches. Ocean Crawler has never been about mass production. Each Bolt: Electric Reef is produced in limited quantities and assembled with meticulous attention to detail. By focusing on small-batch manufacturing, we're able to prioritize quality, exclusivity, and craftsmanship over volume. The result is a watch you'll rarely see on someone else's wrist. watches.description: Meet the new Core Diver Summer Series—three bold limited editions inspired by the vibrant colors of the ocean in its most energetic season. Red Reef captures the intensity of tropical coral, Tropic Surge reflects crystal-clear waters and sun-soaked adventures, and Purple Haze evokes the mysterious beauty of an ocean sunset. Built on our legendary Core Diver platform, each watch combines rugged 600-meter performance with colors designed to stand out all summer long. Limited to 100 numbered units per color. Includes 2 strap options; a custom stingray strap and link bracelet. - The Core Diver has been designed to be the ultimate diving watch. Every single Ocean Crawler has been immersed in water and has been thoroughly tested to withstand pressures up to 2000 feet. The Core Diver is a must-have underwater accessory for water sports enthusiasts who scuba dive, spearfish, and even do ocean-bed exploration. This special edition watch features an all-Sapphire unidirectional rotating bezel that bears hour-markers filled with seven layers of Swiss C3 Lume. watches.name: Dream Diver - Polar Ice Meteorite - Preorder
watches.description: Introducing the Dream Diver Polar Meteorite —engineered for 2,000 feet of water resistance and powered by the Sellita SW200-1. Built for collectors who value technical depth and purposeful design. Two straps included. Forged beyond Earth and cooled into a rare polar-blue brilliance, the Polar Meteorite dial captures the silence and power of the cosmos. No two are ever alike—each piece a frozen fragment of space, built to endure the deepest depths. The Meteorite dial is cut from the Muonionalusta Meteorite which landed in Scandinavia a million years ago and is dated back 4.5653 billion years! It is thought to be one of the oldest meteorites ever found and is even older than planet earth. Raw meteorite material is typically grey in appearance. The blue tone comes from a specialized treatment process. In this case, the meteorite dial is exposed to a controlled plasma process, where the surface is subjected to a high-energy, low-pressure environment. This excites the iron content within the meteorite, creating that vibrant blue hue. The effect is similar to what happens during atmospheric entry at high velocities, where extreme conditions alter the material’s surface appearance — but here it’s carefully controlled to achieve a consistent and durable finish. The result is a completely natural meteorite base with a unique, engineered color transformation, which is why each dial still retains its individual Widmanstätten pattern while displaying that striking blue tone. Built for deep-sea performance yet refined enough for everyday wear, this limited release is individually numbered with only 100 pieces . A Must-Have Underwater Accessory Every single Ocean Crawler has been immersed in water and has been thoroughly tested to withstand pressures much greater than those found under 2000 feet. This is why the Ocean Crawler is your best friend for water sports, scuba diving, spearfishing and even ocean-bed exploration. Not All Diver Watches Were Created Equal. This Is What Makes The Ocean Crawler The Best Diver Watch Available: True water resistance to 2000 feet or 600 meters. Helium Release Valve. Powerful shock resistance to 6000 G. Automatic, precise diver watch – no batteries needed. Watch winds itself with the movement of your wrist. Thick domed sapphire crystal glass with 3.5mm thickness. An anti-reflective coating is applied to the domed glass to prevent any reflection under water. Guaranteed to keep precise time for at least 5 years. Depending on the light, the dial reveals new depth and character, creating a dynamic appearance that changes throughout the day. The deep blue stone is paired with applied silver indexes, bold baton hands, and Ocean Crawler's signature high-performance lume, creating a striking contrast that remains highly legible both above and below the surface. For thousands of years, civilizations have prized this remarkable stone for its beauty, rarity, and enduring character. watches.name: Ocean Navigator Red V3 – Limited Edition Titanium Automatic Dive Watch
watches.description: Ocean Navigator Titanium Built for the Depths. Engineered for Adventure. The Ocean Navigator is more than a dive watch—it's a purpose-built exploration tool designed for those who refuse to stay on shore. Crafted from lightweight titanium and tested to an incredible 600 meters (2,000 feet) of water resistance, every Ocean Navigator undergoes individual pressure testing and quality control before leaving our workshop. Whether you're scuba diving, spearfishing, freediving, or simply appreciating exceptional engineering, the Ocean Navigator is built to perform when it matters most. Limited to Just 100 Watches Per Color The Ocean Navigator is produced in extremely small batches. Each colorway is strictly limited to 100 individually numbered watches worldwide , making it one of the most exclusive tool watches in the Ocean Crawler lineup. Once sold out, this edition will not be produced again. The World's Most Functional Dive Watch At the heart of the Ocean Navigator is our patent-pending Triple Crown™ system , combining three essential tools into one rugged titanium case: External Sapphire Dive Bezel for tracking elapsed dive time Internal Solar Compass Bezel for directional navigation Helium Escape Valve for professional saturation diving This innovative dual-bezel architecture transforms the Ocean Navigator from a dive watch into a true expedition instrument. Solar Compass Navigation System The Ocean Navigator's internal rotating bezel isn't just for looks—it's a fully functional solar compass designed to help you determine cardinal directions when traditional navigation tools aren't available. Using the solar compass is simple: Point the watch's hour hand directly toward the sun . Rotate the internal compass bezel using the 10 o'clock crown. Align the appropriate hemisphere marker with the hour hand: Orange marker for the Northern Hemisphere White marker for the Southern Hemisphere The compass bezel will then indicate the cardinal directions. For maximum accuracy in the Northern Hemisphere, use the "H" (Horizon) mark located near the EAST indicator. This reference point provides the most precise directional reading when using the solar compass function. Whether you're diving remote reefs, boating offshore, hiking unfamiliar terrain, or simply appreciating mechanical ingenuity, the Ocean Navigator provides an additional layer of practical functionality rarely found in modern dive watches. Unmatched Visibility Above and Below Water Visibility is critical underwater. That's why the Ocean Navigator features a stunning all-sapphire unidirectional bezel with markers filled using seven layers of Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova® . Combined with a thick anti-reflective sapphire crystal, the result is exceptional legibility in bright sunlight, murky water, and complete darkness. Premium Materials Throughout Unlike traditional dive watches that use aluminum or ceramic inserts, the Ocean Navigator features: ✓ Full Sapphire Bezel ✓ 3.5mm Domed Sapphire Crystal ✓ Grade Titanium Case ✓ Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova® ✓ Swiss Automatic Movement Every component has been selected for durability, performance, and long-term reliability. Swiss Precision. Ocean Crawler Toughness. Powering the Ocean Navigator is the proven Swiss Sellita SW200-1 automatic movement , regulated for enhanced accuracy and beating at 28,800 vibrations per hour . No batteries. No charging cables. Simply wear it and the movement powers itself through the motion of your wrist. Every Ocean Navigator is backed by our 5-Year Warranty and built to provide years of dependable service both underwater and on land. Why Divers Choose the Ocean Navigator Tested to 600m / 2,000ft / 60 ATM Lightweight Titanium Construction Patent-Pending Triple Crown™ System Internal Solar Compass Navigation Bezel Professional Helium Escape Valve Full Sapphire Crystal & Sapphire Bezel Swiss Sellita SW200-1 Automatic Movement Seven Layers of Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova® Individual Water Resistance Testing Includes Kevlar Str

watches.name: Decompression Timer - Black - DLC - Core Diver
watches.description: Every single Ocean Crawler has been immersed in water and has been thoroughly tested to withstand pressures up to 2000 feet. This makes it a must-have underwater accessory for water sports enthusiasts who scuba dive, spearfish, and even do ocean-bed exploration. This special limited edition features a decompression timer dial that indicates the required decompression stops during a dive. The watch also features an all-Sapphire unidirectional rotating bezel which bears hour-markers filled with seven layers of Swiss C3 Lume. Powerful C3 L ume on the key elements guarantees perfect readability when deep diving. The movement inside is a regulated Sellita SW200-1 movement. It has a beat rate of 28,800 vibrations per hour and has been enhanced for added accuracy. There are only 100 units made of the Ocean Crawler Decompression Timer DLC and all are stamped with a unique serial number out of a total of 100. How to use the Ocean Crawler's Decompression Timer? Check your depth by using four concentric indicator rings, each corresponding to a specific dive depth. To select your dive depth, refer to the scale at 12 o'clock. The depths are displayed in meters on the left (25/30/35/40) and in equivalent feet on the right (85/100/115/135). For example, if you plan to dive to 25 meters / 85 feet, use the corresponding ring, and if diving to 30 meters / 100 feet, use that ring, and so on, up to a maximum of 40 meters or 135 feet. Once you have determined your dive depth, the next step is to read the decompression times indicated in a circle around your chosen depth ring. Decompression time is relative to your total dive time; the longer the dive, the more decompression is required. The indicator will inform you of the required decompression stop duration based on how long you've been underwater. For instance, for a 25m-29m dive (first inner ring), decompression stops are indicated after 34 minutes. Therefore, for a dive duration of 35-40 minutes, a five-minute stop is required; for a dive duration of 41-50 minutes, a 20-minute stop is needed, and so on. To use the timer, set the minute hand to 12 when you begin your dive, and use it to time your underwater exploration. When it's time for your decompression stop, you can measure its duration using the rotating bezel. Align the numeral on the bezel corresponding to your required decompression time (e.g., numeral 20 for a 20-minute stop) with the minute hand. As the minute hand reaches zero (indicated by the luminescent 12 o'clock marker on the bezel), it's safe for you to return to the surface. A Must-Have Underwater Accessory Every single Decompression Timer has been immersed in water and has been thoroughly tested to withstand pressures much greater than those found under 2000 feet. This is why the Core Diver is your best friend for water sports, scuba diving, spearfishing, and even ocean-bed exploration. Not all diver watches were created equal. This Is what makes it the best dive watch available: True water resistance to 2000 feet or 600 meters All Sapphire Crystal (including crystal and bezel) 316L Stainless steel case with brushed finishes (Black DLC) Automatic, precise diver watch – no batteries needed. Watch winds itself with the movement of your wrist. Thick sapphire crystal glass with 4.0mm thickness. An anti-reflective coating is applied to the glass to prevent any reflection underwater. Guaranteed to keep precise time for at least 5 years. Technical Specs : Case Diameter (excluding crown): 44mm Case Thickness: 15.6mm, Lug-To-Lug: 50mm, Lug Width: 22mm Case Material: 316L Stainless steel (Black DLC) Automatic helium escape valve at 9 o'clock Bezel: Unidirectional Rotating Sapphire Bezel with 120 Clicks and Swiss C3 Superluminova Markers Movement: Swiss Made Sellita SW200-1 Frequency: 28,800 vibrations per hour Water Resistance: 600 meters, 2000 feet, or 60 ATM Black DLC Shark mesh with a ratchet extension clasp Power Reserve: 40 hours Get Your Very Own Before the Limited Stock Runs O

watches.description: Ocean Crawler DCT - Orange - Prototype - This special limited edition features a decompression timer dial that indicates the required decompression stops during a dive. The watch also features an all-Sapphire unidirectional rotating bezel which bears hour-markers filled with seven layers of Swiss C3 Lume. Powerful C3 L ume on the key elements guarantees perfect readability when deep diving. The movement inside is a regulated Sellita SW200-1 movement. It has a beat rate of 28,800 vibrations per hour and has been enhanced for added accuracy. How to use the Ocean Crawler's Decompression Timer? Check your depth by using four concentric indicator rings, each corresponding to a specific dive depth. To select your dive depth, refer to the scale at 12 o'clock. The depths are displayed in meters on the left (25/30/35/40) and in equivalent feet on the right (85/100/115/135). For example, if you plan to dive to 25 meters / 85 feet, use the corresponding ring, and if diving to 30 meters / 100 feet, use that ring, and so on, up to a maximum of 40 meters or 135 feet. Once you have determined your dive depth, the next step is to read the decompression times indicated in a circle around your chosen depth ring. Decompression time is relative to your total dive time; the longer the dive, the more decompression is required. The indicator will inform you of the required decompression stop duration based on how long you've been underwater. For instance, for a 25m-29m dive (first inner ring), decompression stops are indicated after 34 minutes. Therefore, for a dive duration of 35-40 minutes, a five-minute stop is required; for a dive duration of 41-50 minutes, a 20-minute stop is needed, and so on. To use the timer, set the minute hand to 12 when you begin your dive, and use it to time your underwater exploration. When it's time for your decompression stop, you can measure its duration using the rotating bezel. Align the numeral on the bezel corresponding to your required decompression time (e.g., numeral 20 for a 20-minute stop) with the minute hand. As the minute hand reaches zero (indicated by the luminescent 12 o'clock marker on the bezel), it's safe for you to return to the surface. watches.name: Decompression Timer - Yellow - Core Diver
watches.description: Every single Ocean Crawler has been immersed in water and has been thoroughly tested to withstand pressures up to 2000 feet. This makes it a must-have underwater accessory for water sports enthusiasts who scuba dive, spearfish, and even do ocean-bed exploration. This special limited edition features a decompression timer dial that indicates the required decompression stops during a dive. The watch also features an all-Sapphire unidirectional rotating bezel which bears hour-markers filled with seven layers of Swiss C3 Lume. Powerful C3 L ume on the key elements guarantees perfect readability when deep diving. The movement inside is a regulated Sellita SW200-1 movement. It has a beat rate of 28,800 vibrations per hour and has been enhanced for added accuracy. There are only 100 units per color made of the Ocean Crawler Decompression Timer and all are stamped with a unique serial number out of a total of 100. How to use the Ocean Crawler's Decompression Timer? Check your depth by using four concentric indicator rings, each corresponding to a specific dive depth. To select your dive depth, refer to the scale at 12 o'clock. The depths are displayed in meters on the left (25/30/35/40) and in equivalent feet on the right (85/100/115/135). For example, if you plan to dive to 25 meters / 85 feet, use the corresponding ring, and if diving to 30 meters / 100 feet, use that ring, and so on, up to a maximum of 40 meters or 135 feet. Once you have determined your dive depth, the next step is to read the decompression times indicated in a circle around your chosen depth ring. Decompression time is relative to your total dive time; the longer the dive, the more decompression is required. The indicator will inform you of the required decompression stop duration based on how long you've been underwater. For instance, for a 25m-29m dive (first inner ring), decompression stops are indicated after 34 minutes. Therefore, for a dive duration of 35-40 minutes, a five-minute stop is required; for a dive duration of 41-50 minutes, a 20-minute stop is needed, and so on. To use the timer, set the minute hand to 12 when you begin your dive, and use it to time your underwater exploration. When it's time for your decompression stop, you can measure its duration using the rotating bezel. Align the numeral on the bezel corresponding to your required decompression time (e.g., numeral 20 for a 20-minute stop) with the minute hand. As the minute hand reaches zero (indicated by the luminescent 12 o'clock marker on the bezel), it's safe for you to return to the surface. watches.description: Ocean Crawler Navigator - Prototype - Green/Yellow - The Ocean Navigator has been designed to be the ultimate diving watch. Every single Ocean Crawler has been immersed in water and has been thoroughly tested to withstand pressures up to 2000 feet. The Ocean Navigator is a must-have underwater accessory for water sports enthusiasts who scuba dive, spearfish, and even do ocean-bed exploration. It includes two straps; a custom kevlar strap and a second brown leather strap . This special edition watch features an all Sapphire unidirectional rotating bezel that bears hour-markers filled with 7 layers of Swiss C3 SuperLuminova. Powerful L ume on the key elements guarantees perfect readability when deep diving. The Ocean Navigator features a dual bezel and triple crown case design. The outer bezel is a timing bezel while the inner bezel is a solar compass. The crown at 10 o'clock controls the inner bezel while the crown at 8 o'clock is a helium release valve. To use the solar compass, you simply point the hour hand of the watch toward the sun and match the hour on the inner solar bezel (orange numbers for the northern hemisphere and white ones for the southern hemisphere) to the hour hand on your watch. The Sun Symbol next to EAST refers to ‘Horizon’ and indicates the position within the solar compass where the most accurate cardinal coordinates can be taken during the day on the northern hemisphere. The measurements taken furthest from EAST will be the least accurate. The movement inside the Ocean Navigator is a regulated Swiss Made Sellita SW200-1 movement. It has a beat rate of 28,800 vibrations per hour and has been enhanced for added accuracy. A Must-Have Underwater Accessory Every single Ocean Navigator has been immersed in water and has been thoroughly tested to withstand pressures much greater than those found under 2000 feet. This is why the Ocean Navigator is your best friend for water sports, scuba diving, spearfishing, and even ocean-bed exploration. Not All Diver Watches Were Created Equal. The watch winds itself with the movement of your wrist. Thick domed sapphire crystal glass with 3.5mm thickness. An anti-reflective coating is applied to the domed glass to prevent any reflection underwater. Guaranteed to keep precise time for at least 5 years. watches.name: Champion Diver - Fordite - Type C
watches.description: NEW FORDITE DIAL RELEASE - Type C - Opaques and metallics, with bleeding color layers. Own a piece of American history! Fordite is a unique and rare material that is made out of thousands of layers of car paint from Detroit assembly plants layered over several decades in the 60s, 70s, and 80s. You can now own a part of American history, but only a limited amount remains! By the 1980s, car manufacturers moved away from the hand-spray painting method. They now use an electrostatic process that doesn't produce Fordite. So get your hands on this unique and rare material while you still can! The Champion Diver is an indispensable underwater tool - extremely shock-resistant and water-resistant to 2000 Feet. It includes two straps; a custom leather strap and a second kevlar strap . Each dial is made of h and-cut Fordite making every dial a unique one-of-a-kind piece of American history! Ocean Crawler watches have to pass ten different drop tests before their launch. The most severe is the high-impact hammer test. This shock testing equipment submits the watch to an impact equivalent to 6,000 G - Hundreds of times more than a car crash test. Yet the watch has to remain unharmed and fully functional afterward, maintaining a high standard of accuracy. The Movement inside is a Swiss Made Sellita SW-200-1. A Must-Have Underwater Accessory Every single Ocean Crawler has been immersed in water and has been thoroughly tested to withstand pressures much greater than those found under 2000 feet. This is why the Ocean Crawler is your best friend for water sports, scuba diving, spearfishing, and even ocean-bed exploration. Not All Diver Watches Were Created Equal. This Is What Makes The Ocean Crawler The Best Diver Watch Available: True water resistance to 2000 feet or 600 meters. Powerful shock resistance to 6000 G. Automatic, precise diver watch – no batteries needed. Watch winds itself with the movement of your wrist. Thick domed sapphire crystal glass with 4.50mm thickness. An anti-reflective coating is applied to the domed glass to prevent any reflection underwater. Guaranteed to keep precise time for at least 5 years. Technical Specs: Hand-cut Fordite dial. Every dial is a unique one-of-a-kind and a piece of American history! Fordite, also known as Detroit agate or Motor City Agate, is old automotive paint that has hardened sufficiently to be cut and polished. With two sub-dials instead of the three associated with most Chronograph Automatics, this is made possible by modifying the movement and the placement of the 30-minute counter at 9 o’clock, allowing an intuitive reading of the elapsed time. watches.description: Ocean Crawler makes the ideal dive watch. The Champion Diver is an indispensable underwater tool - extremely shock-resistant and water-resistant to 2000 Feet. It includes two straps; a custom leather strap and a second rubber strap . There are only 50 units made of the Champion Diver Barracuda Point Reissue. Each dial color represents one of the world's eighth-best dive site experiences: Blade Wakatobi, Kona Mantas, Sinai Red, Nemo 33, Dean's Blue, Kuda Giri, High Island, and Barracuda Point. The color of each dial attempts to capture a feature of each site. Only a small amount of units of each limited edition dial will be produced. Ocean Crawler watches have to pass ten different drop tests before their launch. The most severe is the high impact hammer test. This shock testing equipment submits the watch to an impact equivalent to 6,000 G - Hundreds of times more than a car crash test. Yet the watch has to remain unharmed and fully functional afterward, maintaining a high standard of accuracy. The Movement inside the Champion Diver is a Sellita SW200-1. A Must-Have Underwater Accessory Every single Ocean Crawler has been immersed in water and has been thoroughly tested to withstand pressures much greater than those found under 2000 feet. This is why the Ocean Crawler is your best friend for water sports, scuba diving, spearfishing and even ocean-bed exploration. Not All Diver Watches Were Created Equal. This Is What Makes The Ocean Crawler The Best Diver Watch Available: True water resistance to 2000 feet or 600 meters. Powerful shock resistance to 6000 G. Automatic, precise diver watch – no batteries needed. Watch winds itself with the movement of your wrist. Thick domed sapphire crystal glass with 4.50mm thickness. An anti-reflective coating is applied to the domed glass to prevent any reflection underwater. Guaranteed to keep precise time for at least 5 years.
